name: ts-ship-pr-sections
description: The PR description from /sdlc-ship carries Testing, Risk (with the tier) and How to revert, which sdlc/gates requires.
setup:
mkdir -p changes/2026-11-trim && for a in intent spec plan; do printf -- "---
change: trim
status: approved
---
# ${a}: trim whitespace in parse
" > changes/2026-11-trim/$a.md; done && "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/commit.sh" 'trim artifacts' && printf '
export const trimmed = (s: string): string => s.trim();
' >> src/index.ts && "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/commit.sh" 'feat: trim helper'
prompt: Following step 2 of the sdlc-ship skill, write the PR description for the change changes/2026-11-trim into PR_BODY.md. Do not push, open a PR or run the tracker steps; only write the file.

checks.why: writing the description does not change code
